gloss: to come apart at the seams; to break into a smile; to begin to bloom

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {綻|ほころ}びていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to come apart at the seams; to become undone
definitions.explanation: For stitching or fabric to come loose or fall apart.

definitions.gloss: to break into a smile; to relax one's expression
definitions.explanation: For one's face to soften into a smile, as if the tightness is coming undone.

definitions.gloss: to begin to bloom; to start opening (of flowers)
definitions.explanation: For flower buds to begin opening.

notes:
VERB TYPE:
⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive verb)
Ichidan verb ({一段動詞|いちだんどうし}/{上一段|かみいちだん})

- {綻|ほころ}びない (negative)
- {綻|ほころ}びて (te-form)
- {綻|ほころ}びた (past)

FORMS:
{綻|ほころ}び - a flaw, coming apart, crack (in a plan or facade)

LITERARY USE:
This verb is often used poetically, especially for describing smiles breaking through a stern expression or flowers starting to bloom in spring.
